name: barbell snatch deadlift
description: A deadlift with a wide snatch grip. It strengthens the pulling position used in the snatch.
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip.
Set your back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close.
Stand tall with your hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar with control along the same path.
